crossRefs.note: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.
Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
It shall be for a sign on your hand, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of hand Yahweh brought us out…
You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living…

translations.web: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
translations.bsb: Bind them always upon your heart; tie them around your neck.
translations.kjv: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
translations.asv: Bind them continually upon thy heart; Tie them about thy neck.
